The main takeaway from our work is that
the risk assessment of BD and other genotoxic carcinogens should be based on the internal dose of the genotoxic metabolites, and not on the parent compound.
the large difference in cancer test outcome with BD could be explained quantitatively by a difference in the cancer-initiating potency of the metabolites.
the risk assessment of genotoxic carcinogens can be based on the total genotoxic potency, which can be calculated from the AUC of all the genotoxic metabolites and their respective genotoxic potency.
